title: Nothing but the Blood
lyrics_original: Your blood speaks a better word
Than all the empty claims I've heard upon this earth
What can wash away our sins?
What can make us whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus
What can wash us pure as snow?
Welcomed as the friends of God
Nothing but Your blood King Jesus
Tells of the Father's heart to make a way for us

bible_verses.telugu: క్రొత్తనిబంధనకు మధ్య వర్తియైన యేసునొద్దకును హేబెలుకంటె మరి శ్రేష్ఠముగ పలుకు ప్రోక్షణ రక్తమునకును మీరు వచ్చియున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే ఆయన వెలుగులోనున్న ప్రకారము మనమును వెలుగులో నడిచినయెడల. మనము అన్యోన్యసహవాసము గలవారమై యుందుము; అప్పుడు ఆయన కుమారుడైన యేసు రక్తము ప్రతి ఎ
bible_verses.english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

bible_verses.telugu: దేవుని కృపామహదైశ్వర్యమునుబట్టి ఆ ప్రియునియందు ఆయన రక్తమువలన మనకు విమో చనము, అనగా మన అపరాధములకు క్షమాపణ  మనకు కలిగియున్నది.
bible_verses.english: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God’s grace.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible gift of Your redeeming blood. When guilt or fear try to whisper lies to my soul, remind me of the better word You have spoken over my life. Thank You for washing me pure as snow and bringing me close as Your friend. Help me walk today in the peace, freedom, and security of Your grace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In a world filled with endless noise and striving, Jesus offers us a truth that cuts through every doubt: His sacrifice is completely enough. His precious blood doesn't just cleanse our past mistakes; it speaks a word of grace, righteousness, and eternal peace over our lives. Because of Jesus, we are no longer distant strangers trying to earn approval, but fully forgiven friends welcomed into God's presence. Today, rest from your striving and let your heart rejoice in the quiet confidence of His finished work.
